Instructure, the edtech company behind Canvas LMS, claims to have reached an agreement with the ShinyHunters extortion group to prevent stolen data from being leaked online. ShinyHunters claimed responsibility for breaching Instructure and stealing over 3.6TB of uncompressed data by exploiting cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities in the Free-for-Teacher environment. The group also defaced Canvas login portals on May 7 with an extortion message. Instructure states the threat actors returned the stolen data and provided shred logs confirming its destruction, and that no customers will be extorted as a result of this incident.
